references.title: Cole and Lancucki (1974), A refinement of the crystal structure of gypsum CaSO4.2H2O, Acta Crystallographica B30, 921-929
references.notes: COD CC0; space group I2/a (No. 15), unique axis b. Unit cell a=5.67, b=15.201, c=6.533 Å, beta=118.6 deg.

references.title: Mineral Data Publishing, Gypsum, version 1
references.notes: Publicly readable; accessed 2026-09-19. Used as a factual citation only; luster is subvitreous, with pearly luster limited to {010} cleavage and silky luster to fibrous material.

provenance.derivation: Habit form selections use standard monoclinic form indices in the I2/a cell basis. Development values, disabled forms, and preferred views are curated visualization choices, not measured growth parameters. The declared monoclinic-b setting selects the core registry basis with unique axis b.

Appearance presets use curated visualization parameters selected to represent common gypsum varieties. The supported vitreous category normalizes the reported subvitreous whole-crystal luster; pearly {010} cleavage and silky fibrous material are not transferred to whole-crystal presets. Values are not measured optical constants.

appearanceClaims.description: Gypsum is colorless or white and may be yellow, tan, blue, pink, brown, reddish brown, gray, or black when coloured by impurities.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: The colour range does not define a measured renderer colour.

appearanceClaims.description: Gypsum is reported as transparent to translucent.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: Diaphaneity does not directly determine the curated transmission value.
The current luster vocabulary does not distinguish subvitreous luster.

appearanceClaims.description: Gypsum crystals may be coarsely striated parallel to [001].
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: The source does not establish a growth-face origin or assign the striations to a shipped growth form.

appearanceClaims.description: Gypsum has pearly luster on {010} cleavage surfaces.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: Cleavage observations must not select generated growth faces.
Fibrous aggregate appearance must not be mapped onto an ordinary growth face.

habits.name: Tabular (Selenite)
habits.description: Clinopinacoid {010} dominant; flat tabular crystal bounded by {110} and {111}. The common selenite habit.

habits.name: Prismatic
habits.description: Prism {110} dominant with clinodome {011} and prism {111}; elongated prismatic habit without prominent {010}.
